glosses: Denotes a part of a set, may be translated as "including" or such as in some situations.

examples.text: Voici le livre dont je parlais.
examples.en: This is the book I was talking about.

examples.text: Prends ce dont tu as besoin.
Prenez ce dont vous avez besoin.
Je sais ce dont tu veux parler.
examples.en: I know what you want to talk about.

examples.text: J'adore la manière dont vous parlez.
examples.en: I love the way you talk.
